example

v0.1.0

Reference example bundle for the SprintEngine Studio design-system schema: warm-neutral surfaces, a single green accent, light + dark modes.

Foundations

Palette

ref colors

ref.color.neutral.0#ffffff

Absolute white. Card surface on light.

ref.color.neutral.50#f7f5ef

Warm paper off-white. Light app background; primary text on dark.

ref.color.neutral.200#e5e1d8

Warm hairline grey for borders on light surfaces.

ref.color.neutral.400#a6a196

Warm mid grey. Muted text on dark surfaces.

ref.color.neutral.500#6e6a60

Warm grey. Muted text on light surfaces.

ref.color.neutral.800#23211b

Warm near-black ink. Primary text on light; hairlines on dark.

ref.color.neutral.900#161511

Warm dark ink. Raised surface on dark.

ref.color.neutral.950#0c0b09

Darkest warm ink. Dark app background; labels on bright accents.

ref.color.green.400#4daf7d

Bright green. Accent hover on dark.

ref.color.green.500#3f9468

Forest green. The accent on dark.

ref.color.green.600#2f6a4a

Deep green. The accent on light.

ref.color.green.700#275842

Deepest green. Accent hover on light.

ref.color.red.300#e08a82

Soft red. Danger on dark surfaces.

ref.color.red.500#b8433a

Deep red. Danger on light surfaces.

sem colors

sem.color.bg.app{ref.color.neutral.50}surface

Root page/application background. The outermost background layer of any page or app shell. Do not: Not for cards or raised panels; use sem.color.bg.surface.

sem.color.bg.surface{ref.color.neutral.0}surface

Card and panel surface, one level above the app background. Cards, panels, inputs, and any content container sitting on sem.color.bg.app.

sem.color.text.primary{ref.color.neutral.800}text

Primary content text. Body copy, titles, labels — the default foreground.

sem.color.text.muted{ref.color.neutral.500}text

Secondary, supporting text. Meta, captions, and supporting copy next to primary text. Do not: Never for actionable copy standing alone.

sem.color.text.on-accent{ref.color.neutral.0}text

Foreground on accent-filled controls. Labels and icons sitting on sem.color.accent.primary or sem.color.status.danger fills.

sem.color.border.default{ref.color.neutral.200}border

Default hairline border. Panel dividers, card edges, and secondary control outlines. Borders carry structure; shadows do not. Do not: Not for form-field boundaries; use sem.color.border.input so unfocused fields stay visible.

sem.color.border.input{ref.color.neutral.500}border

Boundary for form fields that must read as bounded controls. Outlines of text inputs, selects, and other form fields — keeps unfocused controls visible (at least 3:1 against their surface) in both modes. Do not: Not for panel dividers or card edges; use sem.color.border.default.

sem.color.accent.primary{ref.color.green.600}accent

The single accent color. Primary CTA fills and selected states. One accent per view; selection and primary action share it. Do not: Never to convey status (use sem.color.status.*) and never as a large decorative surface fill.

sem.color.accent.hover{ref.color.green.700}accent

Hover shift of the accent. Hover and focus emphasis on accent-filled or accent-outlined controls.

sem.color.status.danger{ref.color.red.500}status

Destructive and error signal. Destructive action fills, error text, and failure marks — status meaning only. Do not: Never as a category or brand color.

sem.color.brand.highlight{ref.color.green.500}accentdeprecated

Deprecated brand highlight, kept to exercise the deprecation schema. Do not adopt; retained only for existing consumers.

Gap between a control's internal elements and between sibling controls. Icon-to-label gaps and gaps in control rows.

Vertical rhythm between page sections. Padding around sections and stacked page regions.

Other tokens

ref.radius.sm5px

Small corner radius for controls and rows.

ref.radius.md7px

Medium corner radius for popovers and cards.

sem.radius.control{ref.radius.sm}radius

Corner radius for interactive controls. Buttons, inputs, chips, and rows.

sem.radius.overlay{ref.radius.md}radius

Corner radius for floating surfaces. Popovers, cards, and modal shells. Keep at most two radii per view.

Glyphs

Principles

The rules of this system that tokens alone cannot carry. Read before designing anything new.

Do

  • One accent per view. Selection and the primary action share sem.color.accent.primary; everything else is neutral ink.
  • Structure with hairline borders (sem.color.border.default), not shadows or cards-on-cards.
  • Status colors mean status. sem.color.status.danger marks destruction and failure — never a category, never decoration.
  • Keep rhythm coarse: at most three font sizes and two corner radii per view.
  • Sentence case everywhere. No uppercase-tracking chrome.

Don't (AI-tell anti-patterns)

  • No blue-shifted dark surfaces (#0a0d18-family hues). The dark scale here is warm ink; blue-tinted darks are the single strongest generated-UI tell.
  • No purple-to-blue gradient CTAs, glassmorphism panels, or glow shadows.
  • No inventing intermediate tokens. If a value is missing, add it to tokens.tokens.json with semantics — never hard-code it in component CSS.
  • No second accent. If a design "needs" two accents, the hierarchy is wrong.

Voice

Copy is calm, specific, and short. Buttons name the action ("Save draft"), not enthusiasm ("Let's go!").

Components

Button

Button — light

Variants left to right: primary, secondary, danger, disabled.

Button — dark

The same markup under data-mode="dark"; only tokens change.

The single action control. One primary button per view; it shares the accent with selection.

Anatomy

  • Container: .ds-button — accent fill, sem.radius.control corners, sem.space.control-gap internal gap.
  • Label: sentence-case action verb, sem.font.size.body at sem.font.weight.emphasis.
  • Optional leading icon: .ds-button__icon, 14px, currentColor stroke.

Variants

  • Primary (.ds-button) — sem.color.accent.primary fill with sem.color.text.on-accent label. The one call to action in a view.
  • Secondary (.ds-button--secondary) — transparent fill, sem.color.border.default hairline, sem.color.text.primary label.
  • Danger (.ds-button--danger) — sem.color.status.danger fill; only for destructive actions, always paired with confirmation.

States

  • Hover: primary lifts to sem.color.accent.hover; secondary strengthens its border to sem.color.text.muted.
  • Focus: 2px sem.color.accent.hover outline with 2px offset, on :focus-visible only.
  • Disabled: 50% opacity, not-allowed cursor, no hover response.

Usage

  • Name the action ("Save draft"), never enthusiasm or vague verbs ("Submit").
  • One primary per view; everything else is secondary.
  • Do not use danger styling for emphasis — it is a status color.

Accessibility

  • Real <button type="button"> elements, never styled divs or bare links.
  • Label contrast clears WCAG AA in both modes (sem.color.text.on-accent flips per mode with the accent).
  • Icons are aria-hidden and decorative; the text label carries the meaning.
  • Keyboard: native button semantics; visible focus via :focus-visible.
components/button/component.css
/* Button — consumes semantic tokens only; --ref-* is forbidden in components. */
.ds-button {
  appearance: none;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sem-space-control-gap);
  padding: 6px 14px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-control);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-ui);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-emphasis);
  line-height: 1.4;
  background: var(--sem-color-accent-primary);
  color: var(--sem-color-text-on-accent);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.ds-button:hover {
  background: var(--sem-color-accent-hover);
}

.ds-button:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--sem-color-accent-hover);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.ds-button:disabled {
  opacity: 0.5;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.ds-button--secondary {
  background: transparent;
  border-color: var(--sem-color-border-default);
  color: var(--sem-color-text-primary);
}

.ds-button--secondary:hover {
  background: transparent;
  border-color: var(--sem-color-text-muted);
}

.ds-button--danger {
  background: var(--sem-color-status-danger);
  color: var(--sem-color-text-on-accent);
}

.ds-button--danger:hover {
  background: var(--sem-color-status-danger);
}

.ds-button .ds-button__icon {
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
}
components/button/component.html (demo)
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
    <title>Button — example design system</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../../foundations/tokens.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="component.css" />
    <style>
      /* Demo scaffolding only — real consumers take styles from component.css. */
      body {
        margin: 0;
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-ui);
      }
      .demo-mode {
        padding: var(--sem-space-section);
        background: var(--sem-color-bg-app);
        color: var(--sem-color-text-primary);
      }
      .demo-mode h2 {
        margin: 0 0 4px;
        font-size: 15px;
      }
      .demo-mode p {
        margin: 0 0 12px;
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
        color: var(--sem-color-text-muted);
      }
      .demo-row {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-control-gap);
        padding: var(--sem-space-control-gap) 0;
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <section class="demo-mode" data-mode="light">
      <h2>Button — light</h2>
      <p>Variants left to right: primary, secondary, danger, disabled.</p>
      <div class="demo-row">
        <button class="ds-button" type="button">
          <svg class="ds-button__icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4.5 12.5l5 5 10-11" /></svg>
          Save draft
        </button>
        <button class="ds-button ds-button--secondary" type="button">Cancel</button>
        <button class="ds-button ds-button--danger" type="button">Delete workspace</button>
        <button class="ds-button" type="button" disabled>Save draft</button>
      </div>
    </section>
    <section class="demo-mode" data-mode="dark">
      <h2>Button — dark</h2>
      <p>The same markup under <code>data-mode="dark"</code>; only tokens change.</p>
      <div class="demo-row">
        <button class="ds-button" type="button">
          <svg class="ds-button__icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4.5 12.5l5 5 10-11" /></svg>
          Save draft
        </button>
        <button class="ds-button ds-button--secondary" type="button">Cancel</button>
        <button class="ds-button ds-button--danger" type="button">Delete workspace</button>
        <button class="ds-button" type="button" disabled>Save draft</button>
      </div>
    </section>
  </body>
</html>

Patterns

Sign in — example design system pattern

Sign in

Use your workspace account.

patterns/sign-in.html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
    <title>Sign in — example design system pattern</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../foundations/tokens.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/button/component.css" />
    <style>
      body {
        margin: 0;
        min-height: 100vh;
        display: grid;
        place-items: center;
        background: var(--sem-color-bg-app);
        color: var(--sem-color-text-primary);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-ui);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
      }
      .signin-card {
        width: 320px;
        padding: var(--sem-space-section);
        background: var(--sem-color-bg-surface);
        border: 1px solid var(--sem-color-border-default);
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-overlay);
      }
      .signin-card h1 {
        margin: 0 0 4px;
        font-size: 15px;
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-emphasis);
      }
      .signin-card p {
        margin: 0 0 16px;
        color: var(--sem-color-text-muted);
      }
      .signin-field {
        display: grid;
        gap: 4px;
        margin-bottom: 12px;
      }
      .signin-field input {
        padding: 6px 10px;
        border: 1px solid var(--sem-color-border-input);
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-control);
        background: var(--sem-color-bg-surface);
        color: var(--sem-color-text-primary);
        font: inherit;
      }
      .signin-field input:focus-visible {
        outline: 2px solid var(--sem-color-accent-hover);
        outline-offset: 1px;
      }
      .signin-actions {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: var(--sem-space-control-gap);
        margin-top: 16px;
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <main class="signin-card">
      <h1>Sign in</h1>
      <p>Use your workspace account.</p>
      <label class="signin-field">
        Email
        <input type="email" name="email" autocomplete="email" />
      </label>
      <label class="signin-field">
        Password
        <input type="password" name="password" autocomplete="current-password" />
      </label>
      <div class="signin-actions">
        <button class="ds-button ds-button--secondary" type="button">Create account</button>
        <button class="ds-button" type="submit">Sign in</button>
      </div>
    </main>
  </body>
</html>
